groups.title: Accounting and software roles
groups.text: Each role is hired for one client and trained on that client's software and checklists.

head.title: Questions firms ask before they start

items.q: Is this the same as outsourcing a task?
items.a: No. Your staff member works only for your firm, follows your processes and reports to your managers. Riverbend handles the hiring, payroll, office and IT.

items.q: What hours does my team member work?
items.a: Staff work the hours you agree at the start. Most clients choose a shift that overlaps their mornings so questions are answered the same day.

items.q: How long does it take to get started?
items.a: Most roles are filled within four to six weeks, including two weeks of training on your software before live work.
We recruit and train a replacement for the role, and the team lead covers urgent work in the meantime.

items.q: Which software can the team use?
items.a: The team works in the tools you already use. We set up access with your IT team and follow your security rules.
Yes. We send a shortlist and you interview and choose the person who joins your team.

form.title: Tell us about the role
form.text: Share the role, the software it uses and the hours it needs.
form.success_text: A team lead will reply by email to set up a call.
